title: Motor 1 Operational Operating Procedure
content: Motor 1 drives Conveyor A. Motor overload should stop the conveyor immediately. Temperature above 90 °C requires immediate operator attention.

title: Conveyor Belt Safety Rules
content: Ensure door interlock Switch Door_Switch is closed before starting Conveyor A. Maximum speed setpoint is 50 m/s.

title: Feed Pump Dry Run Warning
content: Tank Level below 10% will trigger dry-run interlock for Feed Pump 101.
